_header: The home page's 3D models (assets/hero3d.js). `board`: a glTF binary of the EVN ALPHA, +Y up, its motor ports facing +Z,
scaled to fit and centred; null: hero3d.js builds a placeholder from boxes (and shows no scenes). `long_mm`: the model's
long side in mm. `explode`: a node's offset in mm along the board's up in the exploded view (the board's entrance), the
marketing renders' own (product_renders/blender_scene.py EXPLODE_MM). `scenes`: the chapters' scenes, in the board's frame,
without the board (hero3d.js POSES names them): motors = scenes.SCENES motors, sensors = peri_sensors, displays =
All are the marketing repository's Blender scenes (kenchow96/EVN-Marketing product_renders: blender_scene.Product and
set_scene, every cable at its routed length) at their full geometry, exported by docs/session/2026-11-10_site76/data/blender_to_glb.py (bpy 5.2.1) and
compressed with glTF Transform 4.1.1 (optimize, then meshopt with a scene-wide quantization volume; simplification only within 0.05 %; the commands
is in that session's data/sources.md). Budget (scripts/test_site.js): each file at most 6 MB, all of them at most 14 MB
(about 7 MB gzipped, as GitHub Pages serves them); the board first, each scene only as its chapter comes near.

`environment`: the marketing renders' studio HDRI (product_renders' studio_small_09, cut to 512 x 256 by that session's data/hdri_to_web.py), turned by `turn_deg` about +Y, loaded once the board is up. `phone_scenes`: the scenes loaded at 760 px and under (the others' chapters show the board alone).
